Yes — CAD $1,000/month is realistic, but I’d treat it as a lean starter budget, not a full-service agency budget.

The key is separating your marketing fee from the Meta ad spend. For example, if your total budget is $1,000, you could target roughly $400–$600 for content/management and $400–$600 for ads. Some Toronto providers publish packages in that range. 
Avocado Media
+1

Who I’d contact first

Bear&Shark Social Media Agency — Toronto/Etobicoke
Strongest fit if your priority is Reels + Meta ads + measurable lead generation. I'd ask whether they can create a stripped-down package around $1,000.

ORCAFY Marketing Agency — Etobicoke
They specifically offer paid social plus vertical-video/Reels production, so they're worth getting a quote from.

ZimaPeak Marketing Inc. — Toronto
Focuses on Meta ads and social content, including creative designed around paid campaigns.

Avocado Media — Toronto
This is one of the clearest budget matches I found: its published Meta-ad packages start at $400/month, or $500/month for more active optimization, with ad spend separate. 
Avocado Media

HVR Media House — GTA
Their published $999/month Growth package includes 10 short-form videos and paid-ad management, although you'd need to confirm whether the package can fit your exact Reels/Meta requirements and whether ad spend is extra. 
HVR Media House

An especially interesting option

Rav Link publishes a $1,000/month Growth package including 12–16 posts, a mix of Reels/static content, Meta Ads setup/optimization and reporting. Ad spend is explicitly excluded. 
ravlink.ca

So if your $1,000 means management/content only, with ad spend on top, you have quite a few options.

If $1,000 is your absolute all-in monthly ceiling including the money paid to Meta, I'd look for a freelancer or very small agency rather than a conventional full-service agency. For comparison, MetaBaz starts Meta management at $599/month before ad spend, while myBloom starts around $700/month for management. 
MetaBaz
+1

What I'd ask for

I'd send prospects something like:

“I'm looking for someone in Toronto to produce 4–8 Instagram Reels per month and manage Meta/Facebook/Instagram ads. My total monthly budget is CAD $1,000. I already have [footage / a location / products / etc.]. Can you propose the maximum amount of content and ad management you can provide within that budget, with ad spend clearly separated?”

One important warning: don't let someone promise both lots of high-quality video production and sophisticated ad management for $1,000 without clarifying exactly how many shooting hours, Reels, revisions, campaigns and optimization hours are included.

If you tell me what type of business you have (restaurant, clinic, realtor, e-commerce, trades, beauty, etc.), I can narrow this to 3 Toronto providers I'd actually contact first and compare their likely fit for your $1,000 budget.
